phone.description: Enter your phone number registered with {courier}.

pocztex_credentials.description: Enter your Pocztex (Poczta Polska) account credentials.

gls_credentials.description: Enter your myGLS account phone number and password.

allegro_credentials.description: Paste your Allegro QXLSESSID session cookie and choose the account context. Use 'private' for allegro.pl and 'business' for business.allegro.pl (Allegro Biznes).

ups_credentials.description: Log in at ups.com, open your dashboard, then in DevTools (F12) → Network right-click the 'GetIncomingShipments' request → Copy → Copy as cURL, and paste it below. HA keeps the session alive by polling.
